title: The ECB Must Bail Out France

title: The Rise and Fall of Privacy
summary: Privacy is not a natural phenomenon, but rather a historical achievement. It emerged after the Reformation and the wars of religion that followed, reached a high point during the Victorian era, and has now been eroding for decades, long before the advent of the digital economy, social media, and AI.

title: Good Institutions Require Good People

Childish pride and envy, grabbing more of the sweets, Donald Trump-style, do not make for a good society.
